draft: Niesha — five time-critical deals plus fifteen orphans to clean is a real load, and I see you carrying Blackzim and Faxquote at the top of it. Block two hours Tuesday morning to batch-call Blackzim ($5,472) and Faxquote ($3,387) back to back while you're fresh — those two alone are most of your at-risk pipeline. Lean into telecom, where you're running +12pp over the team; that's your fastest close. You're not alone on this — I'm personally on the orphan cleanup, so you focus the human energy on the deals that move. Melvin
